'''March 2001 Chantilly tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Game Parlor, Chantilly, VA on 10 March 2001. Steve won it. It is known from Gordon Marx's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1861">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-gordons-chantilly-tr-3-10-01d1861/ gordons-chantilly-tr-3-10-01], DeckTech (Gordon "Tallus" Marx, 11 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-gordons-chantilly-tr-3-10-01d1861/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Game Parlor, Chantilly, VA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' Steve
